title: Python: Rule 5 decompression
description: Implement Rule 5 OSCORE decompression in Python. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, round-trip passes.
notes: Implemented dedicated Python Rule 5 decompression acceptance coverage in python/tests/schc/test_rule5.py without modifying concurrently dirty SCHC source. Evidence: canonical shared oscore_linklocal vector exact packet/compressed parity; inverse independently packed 174-bit residue; empty OSCORE option/no-payload roundtrip; exact MAX_PACKET_SIZE boundary; all truncated residue lengths; both nonzero padding bits; missing/invalid/duplicate OSCORE options and empty payload marker rejection. Validation: uv run pytest -q tests/schc/test_rule5.py tests/schc/test_headers.py tests/schc/test_headers_rules.py tests/schc/test_codec.py => 126 passed; uv run pytest -q tests/test_vectors.py -k schc => 152 passed; Ruff and mypy on test_rule5.py passed. Broader 'tests/schc tests/test_vectors.py -k schc or rule' => 1495 passed, 2 unrelated failures in actively changing fragmentation/link paths: test_fragment_sender_validates_before_allocation_and_seals_wire_once expects ValueError but current code raises SchcError for truncated Rule 0, and TOFU capacity test expects REPLAY but receives CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED. Rule 5 tests all pass.
close_reason: Rule 5 decompression is fully covered and validated against canonical vectors, inverse/rejection paths, and size boundaries
